description: Create a craft fair pricing and inventory spreadsheet. The spreadsheet template has headers and product names pre-filled. Fill in the cost/time/markup data for 5 products, then create formulas to calculate: Total Cost (Material + Labor), Selling Price (Cost × Markup), Potential Revenue (Price × Quantity), and summary statistics. Apply currency and percentage formatting. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/craft_fair_pricing.xlsx
